The '''Warhounds''' were a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of elite [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that [[Skirmish in the Kwymar sector|fought]] in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]. They were armed with [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]].
